rowText: Ask a parent question that gets no close match ("How do I beat Megaera?"), then in the same chat ask a follow-up naming something new ("what about theseus and asterius"). Read Show details on the follow-up's reply; pass when the reply matches the follow-up's own note, and retrieval shows a fresh line, not a repeat of the parent's.
verdictSentence: Not reached -- this needs the Megaera question to be sent first, and that question never went through (see plan61-MEGAERA-01.json). The follow-up was never asked either.
notes: Blocked by the same ask-box freeze as MEGAERA-01 above. Both the parent question and the planned follow-up ('what about theseus and asterius') were left pinned and ready to use, but no press ever reached the Ask button cleanly enough to send either one.
